name: NAME
cardSymbol_bang: Count as a [BANG!], remove one life point
cardSymbol_miss: Count as a [MISSED!], cancel the effect of [BANG!]
cardSymbol_heal: Regain one life point. Only the player playing this card benefits from this effect, unless otherwise stated
cardSymbol_draw: Draw a card. If "any player" is specified, then you can draw a randow a RANDOM card from his HAND, OR you can CHOOSE one IN PLAY in front of him. In no player is specified, draw the top card of the deck. In any case, cards drawn are added to your HAND.
cardSymbol_discard: Force to discard a card. You can force a specified player to discard a RANDOM card from his HAND, OR you can CHOOSE and discard one card IN PLAY in front of him
cardSymbol_any: You can apply the effect to any chosen player, regardless of the DISTANCE
cardSymbol_all: The effect applies to everyone, except the player who played the card, regardless of the DISTANCE
cardSymbol_any_in_range: The effect applies to any one player, provided that he is within your current RANGE
cardSymbol_range: The effect applies to any one player at a distance on the number or less. [MUSTANG] and [SCOPE] can alter this distance, but weapons in play do not
cardSymbol_drawRange: Before applying the effect draw the top card of the deck and check if described condition is satisfied (discard the drawn card after the check)
